commands.name: search-packages
commands.summary: Search the NuGet gallery by keyword or tag (q=Tags:"bson"), with sort, framework, package-type and prerelease filters, 20 results per page

commands.name: search-packages-v2
commands.summary: Search packages through the OData v2 API, which returns structured metadata (id, version, downloads, description) with offset paging

commands.name: get-package
commands.summary: Get the gallery page for the latest version of a package: title, version, target frameworks, install command and README text

commands.name: get-package-version
commands.summary: Get metadata for one package version through the OData v2 API: dependencies, downloads, hash, size, dates, project URL

commands.name: list-package-versions
commands.summary: List all versions of a package with their per-version download counts and publish dates (OData v2 FindPackagesById)

commands.name: get-package-feed
commands.summary: Get the Atom feed of a package's versions, newest first, with update times and links

commands.name: get-package-license
commands.summary: Get the license text of a specific package version

commands.name: get-package-download-stats
commands.summary: Get download counts for a package, broken down by version, client name or client version

commands.name: get-package-version-download-stats
commands.summary: Get download counts for one package version, broken down by client name or client version

commands.name: get-gallery-totals
commands.summary: Get gallery-wide totals: total downloads, unique packages, total package versions, last update time

commands.name: get-stats-overview
commands.summary: Get the statistics overview: top 10 packages, top 10 package versions, and NuGet client usage over the last 6 weeks

commands.name: list-top-packages
commands.summary: List the top 100 most downloaded packages over the last 6 weeks (all packages, followed by community-only rows)

commands.name: list-top-package-versions
commands.summary: List the most downloaded package versions over the last 6 weeks

commands.name: get-owner-profile
commands.summary: Get a NuGet user or organization profile: package count, total downloads, and the packages they own

commands.name: list-client-downloads
commands.summary: List downloadable NuGet client tools (nuget.exe, VS VSIX, and others) with their versions, URLs and release dates
